title: Adrip with Kereska's Acid (Condition)
html:
Adrip with Kereska's Acid

  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
  • Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of  Noxious Fumes upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest.

Properties

 Stack ID: MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE

 Loses duration: start of turn

 If already applied: replace current

Grants:

 Hunger of Hadar ( + )
Creatures within this black sphere are  Blinded and take damage at the end of their turn and the start of their turn.
 Melf's Acid Arrow ( + )
Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals ⁠4d4 Acid damage immediately and ⁠2d4 Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn. If the spell misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage at the end of its next turn.

Condition: Noxious Fumes

 Noxious Fumes

 DEX Save (DC 13)

  • Hostile creatures in a radius of 3 m (10 ft) take 1d4⁠⁠AcidDRS damage.

Notes

  • The in-game tooltip says this effect inflicts Noxious Fumes for 1 turn, but it actually inflicts it for 3 turns.
  • Possibly applying Noxious Fumes can only occur once per attack. A spell hitting multiple targets will still only make a single saving throw for one of the targets to apply the condition.
  • This is the only variant of  Kereska's Favour that requires a saving throw to inflict its condition. The ice, thunder, and poison variants all apply their respective conditions without a saving throw.

Bugs

  • Additional damage is added solely based on the DamageType flag of the action used. It does not actually check that the action was a spell.

Sources of Adrip with Kereska's Acid

  • Sizzling Cataclysm

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Adrip with Kereska's Acid
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
  • Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of  Noxious Fumes upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast  Melf's Acid Arrow and  Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest.
Conduit of Kereska's Ice
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
  • Its cold spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's ice, it can cast  Cone of Cold at 5th level and  Ice Storm at 4th level once per short rest.
Crackling with Kereska's Lightning
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
  • Its lightning spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it gains 2  Lightning Charges.
  • While attuned to Kereska's lightning, it can cast  Chain Lightning at 6th level and  Lightning Bolt at 3rd level once per short rest.
Gripped by Kereska's Flame
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of Heat.
  • While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast  Fireball at 3rd level and  Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest.
Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Thunder damage.
  • Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Reverberation upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast  Shatter and  Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest.
Vessel for Kereska's Poison
  • Affected entity has resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
  • Its poison spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus.
  • When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of  Poisoned upon the target.
  • While attuned to Kereska's poison, it can cast  Cloudkill and  Ray of Sickness at 5th level once per short rest.
